mekayis.metin: (زَحَلَ) الزَّاءُ وَالْحَاءُ وَاللَّامُ أَصْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلَى التَّنَحِّي. يُقَالُ زَحَلَ عَنْ مَكَانِهِ، إِذَا تَنَحَّى. وَزَحَلَتِ النَّاقَةُ فِي سَيْرِهَا. وَالْمَزْحَلُ: الْمَوْضِعُ الَّذِي تَزْحَلُ إِلَيْهِ.

zemahseri.hakikat: مالي عنه مزحل: مبعد، وقد زحلت عنه. ودخل عليه فزحل له عن مكانه. وعقبة زحول: بعيدة. ورجل زحل وزحلة: متنح عن الشيء.

vikisozluk.baslik: زُحَل • (zuḥal) m
esanlamli: it was seen as the eldest of planets
a rare title given due to its slow movement and prolonged stay in the zodiac
or Venus and Jupiter in another tradition

vikisozluk_etimolojiler.metin: From the root ز ح ل (z ḥ l) meaning "to be distant or remote", "to linger away from others"; so called as it is the furthest and has the slowest orbital period of the classical seven heavenly bodies (counting the Sun and the Moon, without the inclusion of Earth).
See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

mana.dayanak_tanim: (Roman mythology) god of agriculture and vegetation; counterpart of Greek Cronus
